# My Dilemma Is You (Volume 3) by Litera

Dive back into the world of *My Dilemma Is You*, the highly anticipated trilogy that captivated readers after its journey from Wattpad to bookstore shelves. This critically acclaimed novel series continues the compelling story of friendship, secrets, and the choices that define a life.

If you are searching for modern young adult fiction that perfectly blends intense romance with thrilling suspense, look no further. *My Dilemma Is You* is an emotional rollercoaster designed to keep you guessing until the very last page.

## The Story: Friendship, Secrets, and Unavoidable Choices

The story follows Cristina Chiperi, a student from Padova, whose life becomes entangled in secrets she never asked for. After building her following as a storyteller on Wattpad, her narrative has blossomed into a full-length trilogy that readers are obsessed with.

In Volume 3, the emotional stakes reach an all-time high. Cris finds herself grappling with the weight of past eventsâa history that seems determined to repeat itself. When she uncovers a deep secret kept hidden from her by Cam and his friends over years, she feels profoundly betrayed. She yearns for distance, wishing to start anew as if none of her relationships ever existed.

However, even as life appears to settle into a fragile routine, an unexpected incident forces Cris into one final, crucial choice that will determine the fate of everyone she loves. The question remains: how far can these friends go when their paths continue to intersect on the hallways of school?

## A Blend of Romance and Suspense

*My Dilemma Is You* is more than just a romance; itâs a gripping mystery. Critics have praised its unique blend of genres, calling it literature where "romance combines with suspense, creating the feeling that you are watching a spy movie." It captures the electric tension of young adulthood while maintaining the pace and urgency of a thriller.
